verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows AnythingLLM shipping a WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage channel. Embedded chat widgets are website embeds, not messenger surfaces. The developer API is only a building block a user could wire into messengers themselves, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can talk to my assistant from the messengers I already use — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage — not just a bespoke web page
